statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease
The service is to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The service is to optimize rate control management
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
